description: T-3666: which LCIDs Excel resolves to a locale, for every language 0x01-0xFF and sublanguage 0-63. Row r is language r; each cell joins with "~" the 64 texts of TEXT(0.75,"[$-LCID]A/P mmmm") for sublanguages 0 to 63 (an LCID with no locale prints "P March": A/P as written, English names).
